notes: B121.3 completes all ten current Liyu Lake Opportunities with conservative place-specific Camera/Subject/Environment coverage.
The Liyu Lake envelope is deliberately conservative and derived from official ERV lake dimensions plus researched north/south waterfront anchors; it is not an exact shoreline polygon.
Local ecology/trail/light-art subjects use conservative radii based on their curated Camera Zone extents, not inferred generic theme geometry.
All entries remain provisional unless exact subject geometry has separately been verified.
